summary: Examples show an ISBN URN validates while a mailto URI is not a URN.
questions: Is an ISBN URN valid for the urn test?
Is a mailto link a URN?

answer_card.title: urn test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ 'urn:isbn:9780302376463' is urn }}          # True
{{ 'mailto://nowone@example.com' is not urn }} # True
```
